name: nerviz
description: Installs or updates the Nerviz `.claude/` inside a Java project, takes a project on an older Spring Boot line up to the one it requires, and fetches the source to create a new one without a clone. Carries only those three skills: the norms, skills, agents and hook are fetched from the source repository when they run, so there is a single source of truth and nothing to re-copy per release.
